The ablation-degradation signature for (0,6) (probe_acc 31.9%→22.4% when added to top-2 ablation) is real but does NOT establish opposing directionality; it is consistent with (0,6) being a 'pronoun-swap-robust' gender writer (carries gender from non-pronoun tokens) whose ablation removes a salvage pathway.
